description: Operate continuously on useful work, not synthetic quota consumption.

execution.scheduling_note: Use one shared dispatcher rather than per-Worker crons; raise frequency only after monitoring.

budgets.external_api_429_policy: respect Retry-After, exponential backoff with jitter
budgets.rate_limits: per-provider token buckets; no fixed 231/min target
budgets.spend_limit: verify available Cloudflare controls; do not assume hard zero-dollar cap exists

audit.r2: optional long-term immutable-style archive with access controls

security.prohibited: unauthorized external network scans or deployment into third-party infrastructure

known_gaps: billing/usage API coverage and actual entitlements
